physics_goals.quote: No new physics signal is observed, and we set world-leading limits on heavy QCD axions, as well as for the Higgs portal scalar among dedicated searches.
physics_goals.value: Search for long-lived particles and hidden-sector states such as heavy QCD axions and Higgs-portal scalars produced in the NuMI beam

summary.plain: The first big liquid-argon neutrino detector ever built. It ran under an Italian mountain from 2010-2013, was rebuilt at CERN, and now sits at Fermilab as the far detector in a hunt for a possible fourth kind of neutrino.
summary.technical: 760 t (476 t active) liquid argon TPC, led by Carlo Rubbia's collaboration: operated at LNGS on the CNGS beam 2010-2013, refurbished at CERN 2014-2017, shipped to Fermilab in 2017, cryogenically commissioned from February 2020, and taking physics data since 5 November 2021 as the SBN programme's far detector, 600 m from the BNB target.

unique_capabilities.value: The first large-scale liquid argon time projection chamber ever operated, now reused as the SBN far detector
